thread:
maya (design): Quick copy/a11y check—we're updating the Function calling toggle in the model settings. current tooltip is "Enable function calling for this model" which feels vague. can we draft a few options? 

sam (product): Goal: make it clear what toggling does and the consequences (invoking external tools, persisted function config). Also need short aria text for the confirm modal when disabling it on models with active functions. 

jon (devex): suggestion for tooltip (short): "Allow calls to registered functions (tools)". longer help text in panel below. 

luis (accessibility): avoid parentheses, screen readers expand them weirdly. prefer verbs early. Also aria label should include outcome: e.g., "Disable function calling—active functions will not be invoked". But that might be long for a tooltip. 

erin (frontend): UI constraint: tooltip max width ~220px so keep ~6–8 words. maybe: "Allow model to call registered functions" 

maya (design): microcopy options: 1) "Let this model call registered functions (tools)" 2) "Allow model to invoke registered functions" 3) "Enable function calling for this model" — which is clearest? 

luis (accessibility): #2 better. For confirm modal copy: primary heading: "Disable function calling?" body: "This model has 3 active functions configured. Disabling function calling prevents them from being invoked. Requests may fall back to text-only responses." Make the count dynamic in copy. 

sam (product): Also need the confirm CTA wording. avoid just "Confirm". Options: "Disable function calling" (destructive) or "Turn off function calling". 

jon (devex): keyboard flow: modal should autofocus on the primary CTA after a short delay? I'd prefer focus on cancel to avoid accidental destructive action. Also add aria-describedby linking to body. Add role="alertdialog" for screen readers. 

erin (frontend): implementation note: we'll add aria-live="polite" to the toast that appears after action. toast copy: "Function calling disabled for Model X. Active functions will not run." keep short. 

maya (design): Accessibility nit: the tooltip should have an accessible name (aria-label) same as visible copy but not include ellipses or icons. Also add a "Learn more" link in the panel pointing to docs. 

sam (product): Decision: use option 2 for tooltip: "Allow model to invoke registered functions". Confirm modal heading: "Disable function calling?" Body as luis wrote but with pluralization: "This model has {n} active functions configured. Disabling function calling will prevent them from being invoked. Requests may fall back to text-only responses." CTA: "Disable function calling" (primary, destructive). Secondary: "Cancel" (autofocus). Toast: "Function calling disabled for {Model Name}. Active functions will not run." 

maya (design): I'll update the spec + add copy variants for translation. erin can you file a PR for the frontend changes? jon can you add the aria pattern to the accessibility checklist? 

erin (frontend): yep filing PR today. will ping when ready. 

jon (devex): added to checklist. will do a quick smoke test with VoiceOver once PR is up. 

ci-bot: deployment queued for branch/feature/function-toggle-tooltip — status: pending :hourglass: 

maya (design): Thanks all — leaving this thread as spec. :sparkles:
